_README: Label id -> structure of the RIGHT popliteal fossa tracked in the female's full-resolution cryosections (scripts/cryo/vhf_popliteal_track.py + vhf_nerve_volume.py). A KEY, not data.
The vessel masks are the LUMEN, not the wall. Depth order in the fossa, superficial to deep: tibial_n, popliteal_v_r, popliteal_a_r.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female cryosections at full resolution (0.33 mm) via the NCI Imaging Data Commons. Derived data (scripts/cryo/vhf_nerve_track.py).
